Here is a 3-sentence summary of Spotify:

Spotify is a Swedish-founded digital music streaming service that gives users access to a vast library of over 100 million songs, podcasts, and audiobooks through both free (ad-supported) and premium subscription plans. The company operates in over 180 countries, making it the world's largest music streaming platform with more than 600 million active users and roughly 240 million paying subscribers as of recent figures. Spotify went public in 2018 through a direct listing on the New York Stock Exchange and has expanded beyond music into podcasting by acquiring companies like Anchor and Gimlet Media, establishing itself as one of the leading podcast platforms globally.

Here is a 3-sentence summary of Google:

Google is a global technology company best known for its dominant search engine, which processes billions of queries daily and serves as the primary way people access information on the internet. Beyond search, Google offers a wide range of products and services including digital advertising, cloud computing, mobile software (Android), and hardware, making it one of the most diversified tech companies in the world. As a subsidiary of parent company Alphabet Inc., Google is one of the most valuable companies in the world and consistently ranks as one of the most visited websites globally, while its advertising platform generates the vast majority of Alphabet's revenue.
